scope: Three independent completed native TRAIN first episodes: CEM12 generation0 actual strings hit then robot-net failure; separate CEM12 missed-ball recovery; earlier CEM07 generation1 court-landing return. CEM12 whole job is still running.
opening_title: 最新真实效果｜击球、触网失败与落地恢复
opening_lines: 最新方案：空中拍线出球7.30米/秒，越网后机器人触网失败。
同方案另一回合：完成4.45秒合格恢复，但未击中来球。
此前较快回球：7.52米/秒越网并场内落地，目标和恢复失败。
closing_lines: 完整扣杀仍为0；三个独立回合的表现不能合并为一次成功。
出球速度、向下分量、目标落点和稳定恢复尚未同时达标。
视频来自原生全身轨迹；正式A/B各200回合尚未运行。
caveats: Selected independent TRAIN cases do not establish a success rate or formal acceptance.
CEM12 generation0 is complete; the four-generation job remains live at snapshot time.
Case2 is explicitly an earlier CEM07 comparison, not the current controller.
50Hz recorded native body poses are replayed without interpolation; contact stills use exact native substep poses.
Case0 is terminated by robot-net fault before any first landing was observed. No landing is invented.
Case2 landing uses the original first-ground event with the adjacent50Hz body pose; all post-ground ball motion is hidden.
The renderer uses CPU llvmpipe. Recorded solver joint-speed overshoots are retained; this video is not hardware validation.
